## 📝 Descrição

We noticed a behavior change in the RAIDIAM test engine, between 07/25/23 and 07/26/23. We have noticed that no Payments API test modules are no longer passing and being stopped early on. We attach here the information of one of the tests as an example and ask for support in the resolution.

General error in all tests:

Failure summary:INTERRUPTED payments_api_qrdn-good-proxy_test-module_v2: Test was interrupted before it could complete. The failure 'OptionallyAllow201Or422: resource endpoint returned an unexpected http status - either 201 or 422 accepted' means the test cannot continue.

We identified an error checking the jwt, but the certificate was found in the FetchServerKeys step, where the certificate is not expired.

## 1. What Happened and what were you expecting?

We expected the test to proceed normally with the interactions until their normal course.
